items.rationale: The optional glazing peril (2.7) is agreed. Under 1.3 and 2.7.2, drilling to receive the hardware is part of the covered glazing work, so a modest market price is indemnified.

items.description: Installation of new glass into frame
items.rationale: Setting and fitting the replacement element is glazing work covered under 2.7.2 now that the glazing peril is agreed. Indemnified at an ordinary labour price.
The cracked cabinet pane is a glazing element under the agreed optional peril 2.7. The like-for-like made-to-measure pane is indemnified at a fair market price, with no betterment allowed (7.1.10).
One attendance per undertaking is payable under 7.1.12 because covered glazing work was carried out at that visit. The amount follows the low vehicle-charge level seen in the reference cases.
